# temper matrix

Every row is a claim this project declares in `temper/`. A cell is covered only by a
passing evidence record from a test that ran at that level; a skip proves nothing.
Exempt cells are excused by a passing proof. Regenerate with `temper matrix`.

✅ covered · ☑️ exempt · ❌ failing · ⬜ missing · ⏳ unenforced · — not required

## Features

| Feature | What it does | unit | integration |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `adapter.go` | Lets a Go test state what it proves and records how it ended. | ✅ | — |
| `declarations.load` | Reads every declaration into one model, rejecting unknown fields. | ✅ | — |
| `declarations.extension_fields` | Ignores x- fields, so a project keeps its own metadata beside Temper's. | ✅ | — |
| `cli.check` | Validates declarations without running any test and names each problem's file, id and rule. | ✅ | ✅ |
| `cli.matrix` | Joins declarations with evidence and writes the committed statuses and MATRIX.md. | ✅ | ✅ |
| `cli.matrix_json` | Prints the full matrix, errors and summary as JSON for CI and agents. | — | ✅ |
| `cli.matrix_check` | Writes nothing and exits 3 when committed statuses or MATRIX.md are out of date. | ✅ | ✅ |
| `cli.render` | Rewrites MATRIX.md from the committed statuses alone. | ✅ | — |
| `cli.run` | Runs a command with the level and evidence directory set, so no test chooses its own level. | ✅ | ✅ |
| `cli.clean` | Deletes all evidence, the start of a full run. | ✅ | — |
| `cli.version` | Prints the version the binary was built as, whether stamped at release or installed with go install. | ✅ | ✅ |

## Invariants

### adapter

| Invariant | Subject | unit | integration |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `adapter.failure_never_passes` | `adapter.go` | ✅ | — |
| `adapter.level_from_runner` | `adapter.go` | ✅ | — |
| `adapter.never_truncates` | `adapter.go` | ✅ | — |
| `adapter.silent_without_runner` | `adapter.go` | ✅ | — |
| `adapter.skip_records_skip` | `adapter.go` | ✅ | — |

- `adapter.failure_never_passes` — A test that fails, errors or panics never records pass.
- `adapter.level_from_runner` — The level a record carries comes only from TEMPER_LEVEL; no test can set it.
- `adapter.never_truncates` — The adapter only appends, to a file unique to its process; it never truncates or removes evidence.
- `adapter.silent_without_runner` — Without TEMPER_LEVEL and TEMPER_EVIDENCE the adapter records nothing and changes nothing.
- `adapter.skip_records_skip` — A skipped test records skip.

### honesty

| Invariant | Subject | unit | integration |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `declarations.ambiguous_answer_rejected` | `cli` | ✅ | — |
| `matrix.exact_reference_only` | `cli` | ✅ | — |
| `matrix.exemption_needs_passing_proof` | `cli` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `matrix.requires_any_one_level_proves_it` | `cli` | ✅ | — |
| `matrix.scenario_needs_declaration` | `cli` | ✅ | — |
| `matrix.skip_never_covers` | `cli` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `matrix.test_only_credits_nothing` | `cli` | ✅ | — |
| `matrix.unknown_reference_fails` | `cli` | ✅ | ✅ |

- `declarations.ambiguous_answer_rejected` — A lattice answer map that does not say exactly one of supported: true and unsupported: true is an error; it is never read as supported.
- `matrix.exact_reference_only` — Evidence credits only the item its reference names exactly; never by test name, id prefix, file path or level.
- `matrix.exemption_needs_passing_proof` — A cell is exempt only while a passing exempts record from the declared proven_by test exists; a covers record, another test, a skip or a failure leaves it missing or failing.
- `matrix.requires_any_one_level_proves_it` — An invariant with requires_any is proven by a pass, or a proven exemption, at any one listed level; it is a gap once, per subject, only when no level is proven; and a failure at any level is still a gap.
- `matrix.scenario_needs_declaration` — A member of a scenario-covered lattice is credited only by evidence from a declared scenario that lists it, and a member no scenario lists is a gap before any test runs.
- `matrix.skip_never_covers` — A skipped test never makes a cell covered, at any level.
- `matrix.test_only_credits_nothing` — Evidence for a test-only subject credits no cell.
- `matrix.unknown_reference_fails` — Evidence or a declaration that names an id Temper does not know is an error that exits 2; it is never ignored and never creates a row.

### output

| Invariant | Subject | unit | integration |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `matrix.not_run_never_judged` | `cli` | ✅ | — |
| `matrix.output_deterministic` | `cli` | ✅ | — |
| `matrix.stale_output_detected` | `cli` | ✅ | ✅ |

- `matrix.not_run_never_judged` — A level with no evidence keeps its committed statuses and never affects the exit code, unless --all-levels judges it.
- `matrix.output_deterministic` — The same declarations and evidence always produce the same bytes.
- `matrix.stale_output_detected` — matrix --check exits 3 whenever the committed statuses or MATRIX.md differ from what the evidence produces.

## Lattices

### `outcomes`
